lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are organized into roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill area. The spacing between clusters is relatively consistent within columns, while horizontal spacing between columns increases toward the posterior region of the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the primary horizontal rows and vertical columns of spots, forming a coordinate-like grid where the high-intensity blobs act as nodal points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Linear horizontal features are present across the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient. These features show high-intensity values on the dorsal-facing edge and significant shadowing on the ventral-facing edge, indicating structural ridges.
